parameters.name: FtkCodexPrices3
parameters.label: Shared base query
parameters.description: Shared Codex hub price lookup, part 3 of 3. Workbooks expand parameters only once, so the block is split around its cross-cluster references and each query rejoins the parts.
parameters.value:
.Prices
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens" and PricingUnit == "Units"
    | where isnotnull(x_PricingBlockSize) and x_PricingBlockSize > 0
    | extend Tier = extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter), Scope = extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter)
    | extend Model = strcat("gpt-", replace_string(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter), " ", "-")),
             Context = iff(extract(meterRx, 2, SkuMeter) == "LongCo", "long", "short"),
             Op = extract(meterRx, 3, SkuMeter)
    | join kind=inner billedCombos on Model, Tier, Scope
    | where x_EffectivePeriodStart <= now()
    | extend C = todouble(ContractedUnitPrice) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0,
             L = todouble(iff(isnull(ListUnitPrice) or ListUnitPrice <= 0, ContractedUnitPrice, ListUnitPrice)) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0
    | summarize C = max(C), L = max(L), IngestedAt = max(x_IngestionTime), Currency = take_any(PricingCurrency)
      by Model, Context, Op, x_EffectivePeriodStart, x_EffectivePeriodEnd
    | summarize arg_max(x_EffectivePeriodStart, *) by Model, Context, Op
    | summarize i = round(maxif(C, Op == "Inp"), 8), cr = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                cw = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), o = round(maxif(C, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                li = round(maxif(L, Op == "Inp"), 8), lcr = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                lcw = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), lo = round(maxif(L, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                pStart = min(x_EffectivePeriodStart), pEnd = max(x_EffectivePeriodEnd), ops = dcount(Op),
                pIngest = max(IngestedAt), pCur = take_any(Currency)
      by Model, Context
    | where ops == 4);
let price = toscalar(priceRows
    | extend ctx = bag_pack(Context, bag_pack("i", i, "cr", cr, "cw", cw, "o", o, "li", li, "lcr", lcr, "lcw", lcw, "lo", lo))
    | summarize ctxBag = make_bag(ctx) by Model
    | extend m = bag_pack(Model, ctxBag)
    | summarize b = make_bag(m) | project b);
let priceStart = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pStart));
let priceEnd = toscalar(priceRows | summarize min(pEnd));

parameters.name: FtkCodexCosts
parameters.label: Shared base query
parameters.description: Shared Codex cost projection. Workbooks have no baseQueries primitive, so the definition lives here once and each token economics tile references {FtkCodexCosts}.
parameters.value:
let priceRowCount = toscalar(priceRows | count);
let priceIngested = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pIngest));
let priceCurrency = toscalar(priceRows | summarize take_any(pCur));
let pricesLoaded = priceRowCount > 0;
let spans = materialize(dependencies
| where (timestamp >= StartTime and timestamp < EndTime)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name in ('session_task.turn', 'session_task.run', 'run_turn', 'run_sampling_request', 'try_run_sampling_request', 'receiving_stream', 'handle_responses')
| where name != 'handle_responses' or isnotnull(todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']))
| summarize take_any(timestamp, name, operation_ParentId, customDimensions, duration) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, id);
let turns = spans
| where name == 'session_task.turn'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, turnSpanId = id, turnStarted = timestamp, duration_s = duration / 1000.0,
          turnModel = tostring(customDimensions['model']), thread = tostring(customDimensions['thread.id']), turn = tostring(customDimensions['turn.id']),
          turnInput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens']),
          turnCached = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens']),
          turnWritten = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cache_write_input_tokens']),
          turnOutput = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens']),
          turnTotal = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']);
let responseUsage = spans
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         written = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         streamId = operation_ParentId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'receiving_stream'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId = id, samplingId = operation_ParentId) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | where name == 'try_run_sampling_request'
    | project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId = id, requestId = operation_ParentId, model = tostring(customDimensions['model'])) on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId
| extend context = iff(input > 272000, 'long', 'short')
| extend p = price[model][context], shortPrice = price[model]['short'];
// Cache-write pricing replaces ordinary input pricing for the same tokens.
// https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching#monitor-cache-performance
// An absent exported write counter is unknown, not zero (Codex 0.142.0 does not emit it).
let responseCosts = materialize(responseUsage
| extend coreUsageValid = coalesce(total >= 0 and input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input
    and output >= 0 and total == input + output, false),
         priceValid = pricesLoaded and isnotnull(p) and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd
| extend priceStatus = case(not(pricesLoaded), 'Price data unavailable',
                            isempty(model), 'BUG: Missing response model',
                            isnull(p), 'BUG: Model missing from price map',
                            timestamp < priceStart or timestamp >= priceEnd, 'Price outside effective period',
                            not(coreUsageValid), 'Invalid or missing token usage',
                            isnull(written), 'Cache-write counter missing',
                            written < 0 or cached + written > input, 'Invalid cache partition',
                            'Priced'),
         uncached = input - cached - written
| extend input_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', uncached * todouble(p.i) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cached_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, cached * todouble(p.cr) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         write_cost_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced', written * todouble(p.cw) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         output_cost_usd = iff(priceValid and coreUsageValid, output * todouble(p.o) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         retail_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * todouble(p.li) + cached * todouble(p.lcr) + written * todouble(p.lcw) + output * todouble(p.lo)) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         cache_benefit_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (cached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(p.cr)) - written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(p.i))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         context_premium_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.i) - todouble(shortPrice.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.cr) - todouble(shortPrice.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.cw) - todouble(shortPrice.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.o) - todouble(shortPrice.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null)),
         negotiated_discount_usd = iff(priceStatus == 'Priced',
             (uncached * (todouble(p.li) - todouble(p.i)) + cached * (todouble(p.lcr) - todouble(p.cr))
              + written * (todouble(p.lcw) - todouble(p.cw)) + output * (todouble(p.lo) - todouble(p.o))) / 1000000.0, real(null))
| extend cost_usd = input_cost_usd + cached_cost_usd + write_cost_usd + output_cost_usd

parameters.name: FtkAgentPrices2
parameters.label: Shared base query
parameters.description: Shared Agent framework hub price lookup, part 2 of 2. Workbooks have no baseQueries primitive and expand parameters only once, so the block is split around its cross-cluster references and each query rejoins the parts.
parameters.value:
.Prices
    | where SkuMeter endswith '1M Tokens' and PricingUnit == 'Units'
    | where isnotnull(x_PricingBlockSize) and x_PricingBlockSize > 0
    | where x_EffectivePeriodStart <= now() and x_EffectivePeriodEnd > now()
    | extend RawKind = tolower(extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter))
    | where isnotempty(RawKind)
    | extend RawCtx = tolower(extract(meterRx, 2, SkuMeter)),
        RawTier = tolower(coalesce(extract(meterRx, 3, SkuMeter), extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter))),
        RawScope = tolower(extract(meterRx, 6, SkuMeter))
    | extend ModelKey = normalizeModel(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter)),
        Context = case(RawCtx == 'longco', 'long', RawCtx == 'shortco', 'short', 'any'),
        Tier = iff(RawTier == 'pp', 'priority', 'standard'),
        Scope = case(RawScope startswith 'dz', 'data zone', RawScope startswith 'rg', 'regional', 'global'),
        Kind = case(RawKind == 'cd wr', 'cw', RawKind startswith 'cd ' or RawKind startswith 'cchd', 'cr', RawKind in ('inp', 'inpt'), 'i', 'o')
    | where Scope =~ wantScope and Tier =~ wantTier and Context in~ (wantContext, 'any')
    | extend Rate = todouble(ContractedUnitPrice) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0
    | summarize Rates = dcount(Rate), Rate = take_any(Rate), Currency = take_any(PricingCurrency) by ModelKey, Kind);
// More than one distinct rate for a model and token kind means the meter cannot be
// resolved, so the model is reported as ambiguous instead of picking a rate.
let ambiguousModels = coalesce(toscalar(priceRates | where Rates > 1 | summarize s = make_set(ModelKey) | project s), dynamic([]));
let price = toscalar(priceRates
    | where Rates == 1
    | summarize kinds = make_bag(bag_pack(Kind, Rate)) by ModelKey
    | summarize b = make_bag(bag_pack(ModelKey, kinds))
    | project b);
let priceCurrency = toscalar(priceRates | summarize take_any(Currency));
let pricesLoaded = toscalar(priceRates | count) > 0;

parameters.name: FtkAgentUsage
parameters.label: Shared base query
parameters.description: Shared Agent framework span attribution. Workbooks have no baseQueries primitive, so the definition lives here once and each query references {FtkAgentUsage}.
parameters.value:
let agentSpans = materialize(dependencies
| where name has 'invoke_agent' or tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) in ('chat', 'execute_tool')
| extend operation = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']),
    agentId = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.id']),
    agentName = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']),
    provider = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.provider.name'])
// Identity never depends on a provider specific field. Agents without an id or a
// name collapse into one bucket per service, so the roster cannot grow a row per span.
| extend agentKey = case(isnotempty(agentId), strcat(cloud_RoleName, '|', agentId),
        isnotempty(agentName), strcat(cloud_RoleName, '|', agentName),
        strcat(cloud_RoleName, '|(unidentified)')),
    agentLabel = case(isnotempty(agentName), agentName,
        isnotempty(agentId), agentId,
        strcat(cloud_RoleName, ' (unidentified agents)')));
let agentUsage = materialize(agentSpans
| where operation == 'chat'
| extend model = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.model'], customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])),
    inputTokens = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
    outputTokens = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
    cacheReadTokens = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cached_tokens']), long(0)),
    cacheWriteTokens = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']), long(0))
| extend modelKey = normalizeModel(model),
    providerLabel = iff(isempty(provider), '(provider not reported)', provider)
// Only usage billed through Azure can be priced from the hub price sheet. The
// OpenTelemetry enum defines the first two; Microsoft Foundry instrumentation also
// emits the Foundry values, which are observed live, so both spellings are accepted.
// The same model served by another channel, such as GitHub, bills elsewhere and is
// deliberately excluded.
| extend billableInput = coalesce(inputTokens, long(0)) - cacheReadTokens - cacheWriteTokens,
    azureRated = provider in~ ('azure.ai.openai', 'azure.ai.inference', 'azure.ai.foundry', 'microsoft.foundry'),
    claudeModel = modelKey has 'claude'
| extend rates = price[modelKey]
| extend rateInput = todouble(rates.i), rateCacheRead = todouble(rates.cr),
    rateCacheWrite = todouble(rates.cw), rateOutput = todouble(rates.o)
// A rate is required only for a token kind that was actually used.
| extend missingRate = (billableInput > 0 and isnull(rateInput))
    or (cacheReadTokens > 0 and isnull(rateCacheRead))
    or (cacheWriteTokens > 0 and isnull(rateCacheWrite))
    or (coalesce(outputTokens, long(0)) > 0 and isnull(rateOutput))
| extend costingState = case(
    isnull(inputTokens) and isnull(outputTokens), 'Usage counters missing',
    billableInput < 0, 'Usage counters inconsistent',
    not(azureRated), 'Provider not in the Azure price sheet',
    claudeModel, 'Billed as Claude consumption units',
    not(pricesLoaded), 'Price sheet unavailable',
    set_has_element(ambiguousModels, modelKey), 'Meter match ambiguous',
    isnull(rates), 'No matching token meter',
    missingRate, 'Rate missing for a used token kind',
    'Priced')
| extend estimatedCost = iff(costingState == 'Priced',
    (billableInput * coalesce(rateInput, 0.0)
        + cacheReadTokens * coalesce(rateCacheRead, 0.0)
        + cacheWriteTokens * coalesce(rateCacheWrite, 0.0)
        + coalesce(outputTokens, long(0)) * coalesce(rateOutput, 0.0)) / 1000000.0,
    real(null)));

parameters.query:
{"version":"AzureDataExplorerQuery/1.0","queryText":"let months = toscalar(database('Ingestion').HubSettings | project toint(retention.final.months));
let currencies = Costs_v1_2
    | where ChargePeriodStart >= monthsago(iff(isempty(months), 24, months))
    | where isnotempty(BillingCurrency)
    | distinct BillingCurrency;
let currencyCount = toscalar(currencies | count);
currencies
| extend Label = BillingCurrency, _Order = 1
| union (
    print BillingCurrency = '', Label = '⚠️ All', _Order = 0
    | where currencyCount > 1
)
| order by _Order asc, Label asc
| project BillingCurrency, Label
| serialize
| extend selected = row_number() == 1
| project value=BillingCurrency, label=Label, selected","clusterName":"{HubClusterName}","databaseName":"{HubDatabase}"}
